Arkansas Bicycle Club Sunday Ride

Little Rock, AR · Two Rivers Park · Road

Beginner friendly

Arkansas Bicycle Club Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Little Rock, AR. It rolls every Sunday at 1:00 pm from Two Rivers Park Bridge. About 18–35 miles, beginner to intermediate, faster and slower riders.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 1:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner to intermediate, faster and slower riders. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Arkansas Bicycle Club Sunday Ride group ride

The club's standing Sunday afternoon ride from the Two Rivers bridge. Eighteen to 35 miles with an optional Fort Roots climb. The club calls it a good introduction to group riding because faster and slower riders both show up. Tuesday and Thursday morning rides leave from the Big Dam Bridge.
